dict.string: DevSweep looks for regenerable build output (node_modules, target, build…) in projects you keep on your Desktop. It reads folder names and sizes only, and never opens your files.
DevSweep looks for regenerable build output (node_modules, target, build…) in projects you keep in Documents. It reads folder names and sizes only, and never opens your files.
DevSweep looks for regenerable build output (node_modules, target, build…) in projects you keep in Downloads. It reads folder names and sizes only, and never opens your files.
Local build. No network access, no telemetry.
DevSweep only needs this if you keep projects on an external drive. It reads folder names and sizes only.
